title: Alketh / Alchethmy
tagline: Alketh / Alchethmy is a Play to Earn NFTCG. Play, Collect and Trade.
description: Alketh / Alchethmy is a Play to Earn Trading Card Game. Collect all the cards, Play with them to increase their value and trade or sell them as NFTs at their highest points. We take the best of card games like Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh and Pokemon, and together with the utilities of Web3 we bring you a Brand New way to play card Games. See the complete presentation at: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1CWgsQ26iSCFNX65ccksVFSyrWQSA_iQABGfiQlT6iz0/edit?usp=sharing
how_its_made: This project mixes TCGs ans Web3 tools in the most useful way, making the players the owners of their digital cards. We use the technology of our sponsors (OpenSea, Polygon, Tatum, Skale, Boba, Cronos and IPFS & FileCoin) to make it easier for our players to trade cards, convert them to NFTs and get the cards back, to keep playing with them.
